inherited_requirements.statement: Measure distinct HIGH and LOW pressure channels. Preserve raw ADC, voltage, calibration identity and absolute/gauge reference; publish no engineering pressure without exact validated calibration.
Provide selected high-line, low-line and ambient temperature inputs; cabin return and center vent are optional extensions. Internal die temperature remains BOARD_DIE_HEALTH_ONLY.

Use fused switched vehicle power, reverse-polarity/transient protection, a controller-compatible regulated supply and an independent sensor 5 V supply. Keep USB service available and record reset/brownout evidence.
Independently switch HIGH and LOW sensor power. Account for signal back-powering, off-state leakage and independent fault recovery.
Use an ADS1115-Q1-class protected/scaled ADC path unless measured evidence supports the controller ADC. Include a known reference and all required rail measurements.
Retain microSD logging, raw observations, versioned health and calibration evidence, with power-loss/recovery tests. The current recovery firmware does not implement these paths.
Retain USB flashing/debug and versioned recovery. BLE/SoftAP are later runtime features, absent from EMPTY_RECOVERY and TEMPERATURE_BENCH.
Carry over the current matched enclosure revision. Revalidate any new PCB, shield stack, connector, harness or power-entry geometry against actual exported shell/cassette solids.

Require native ERC/DRC, independent engineering review, exact manufacturing artifacts and measured bench results before fabrication/vehicle qualification. Component ratings and CAD clearance do not certify the complete assembly.

unresolved_contracts.needed: Choose the recent Pi + UNO-size ESP32-S3 arrangement or original Nano; record exact controller manufacturer, SKU, revision, schematic, header pin numbering and voltage/power limits.
Choose a separate sensor PCB, a shield, or an integrated replacement. The current UNO mounting plane already carries the controller; this reference does not create space for a second board.
Freeze exact orderable sensor, connector/cavity pin map, supply and output limits, transfer, pressure reference, faults, calibration and refrigerant/port configuration.
Freeze the LOW variant independently; do not copy HIGH range or use a generic 0.5-4.5 V calibration.
Select exact contact/ambient probes and interfaces, excitation, range, attachment, connector, fault behavior and calibration.
Resolve fused source, continuous/current/startup loads, minimum crank voltage/duration, required hold-up or controlled restart, reverse-polarity and surge waveform limits.
Freeze regulator, upstream node, tolerance, startup/short limits, channel switches, off-state behavior and thermal budget at actual ambient temperature.
If included, identify the exact Pi/HAT, bench/vehicle role, separate power budget and communication link. The modeled lithium UPS HAT is prohibited underhood.
Resolve the seven analog observations versus four ADC inputs, GPIO assignments, reference source, filtering, divider tolerances, settling and power-off input protection.
Freeze onboard socket or measured breakout, voltage domain, GPIO/SPI assignments, card detect, insertion clearance and startup/write current.
Freeze actual sensor/internal disconnect/power connectors, pin maps, locations, cable OD and bend radius, latch/pull travel and strain relief.
Resolve the final board role and outline, attachment, board stacking, populated heights, antenna/USB access and physical mounting coupon evidence.
Freeze board stackup, copper, supplier rules, finish, assembly/package capabilities and component lifecycle/availability.
Resolve actual component/enclosure temperature limits, electrical/transient/environment/EMC acceptance criteria, fixtures, measurement uncertainty and reviewer.

analog_signal_budget.adc_rate_comment: 105 is a minimum observation count (2*50 + 1 reference + 4 rails at 1 Hz), not a proven conversion/settling schedule or simultaneous-sampling claim.
